atAGlance: Nước khoáng is mineral water, a practical menu word to know because still and sparkling bottles may both appear.
whatItIs: Nước khoáng is bottled mineral water; menus may use the same label for still or sparkling bottles. Expect a clean, faintly mineral taste rather than sweetness, fruit, or tea flavor.
howToEnjoy: Specify có ga or không ga if you care about bubbles.
howLocalsOrder: Nước khoáng is a simple water order, but ask for a sealed cold bottle if that matters. Say không đá if you do not want ice added to the glass.
worthKnowing: In Vietnam, Nước khoáng is useful because mineral water may be still or sparkling, so có ga and không ga are the words to notice.
